name: F-16C with 4 × AIM-120 (AIM-120C-DCS), climbing like the DCS AI
description: F-16C-DCS, but it climbs the way the DCS AI flies a route: at about Mach 0.85 whatever speed is commanded, at 0.02 m/s per metre still to climb, no faster than 94% throttle allows. Train on it for DCS.

sources.WPN_COUNT: standard BVR loadout in this project
sources.RCS_M2: commonly cited open-source frontal estimate (≈ 1.2 m²)
sources.SPEED_CMDS: the action set existing checkpoints were trained with
sources.CLIMB_FPA_LO: holds speed on a 3 km climb (measured)
sources.CLIMB_MACH: DCS climbs in 4 recorded fights (dcs_v8 v the DCS AI, 3 runs; the defender mission, 2 runs): Mach 0.82-0.88 with 220, 400 or 550 m/s commanded
sources.CLIMB_THROTTLE: fitted: with 3 km still to climb the model climbs 49-60 m/s at 10-11.5 km (DCS 50-60) and from 9 to 13 km in 89 s (DCS 75-82 s); with 1.2 km to go 23-24 m/s (DCS 22-33)
